extra.reason: Accepted async job-based model with MVP defaults: polling-only (no webhook), 15-min job timeout (ENGINE_TIMEOUT), no cancellation. Lifecycle queued->running->succeeded|failed. Spec: docs/decisions/21.2-execution-model.md

Accepted: required request_id (UUIDv4 idempotency key, 7-day dedup, 409 on key reuse w/ different body, correlation-id tracing) + contract_version (schema negotiation, 400 on unsupported; distinct from engine_version). Spec: docs/decisions/21.4-request-id-and-contract-version.md

Accepted: single canonical source_type enum (email|rfi|site_instruction|meeting_note|sms|document) shared by input documents and output evidence; dropped ambiguous instruction/note; added source_document_id traceability. Spec: docs/decisions/21.1-evidence-type-vocabulary.md

Accepted: two orthogonal axes (detection confidence_score 0-1 vs valuation confidence); canonical band mapping low<0.5<=medium<0.8<=high; engine-derived confidence_band; status kept orthogonal to confidence. Spec: docs/decisions/21.3-confidence-system.md
